scope: source delivery only; no hosted activation, no autonomous action, no natural-event acceptance claim

implemented.resolver: services/evolution/approved_baselines.py resolve_member_baseline approves only with: approved registry entry, checksum/tenant/embedded artifact checksum, replication_success True, an admitted replication_proof (single passed real_backtest_validation, all checks true, numbers equal to evaluation_summary), and the registry owner's proof.owner_verified_binding (run id, artifact checksum, evaluation digest, OOS Sharpe/drawdown/round trips) equal to this member's checksum and summary. No raw cross-owner store is read. Missing/failed/foreign/unbound proof -> explicit no_approved_baseline reason.
implemented.return_basis: member_virtual_book.gate_basis_metrics replays the gate's share-sized cash portfolio per underlying and now matches the genuine vectorbt 1.1.1 from_orders path: Sharpe annualised with vectorbt's default year_freq=365 days (GATE_PERIODS_PER_YEAR=365, baseline periods_per_year=365; not 252), max drawdown peaks from the first bar's value (not init_cash). Parity test test_numerical_parity_with_genuine_vectorbt_gate_path diffs Sharpe (6dp) and drawdown (9dp) against pf.sharpe_ratio()/pf.max_drawdown() for 3 order sequences x equity/ETF tax. Exposure-fraction gross/net blocks stay on 252 with their own basis label and are reported incomparable.
implemented.runtime_entry_point: paper_runtime._member_book_snapshot and PersonaStrategyPoolStore.member_baselines read the entry through the existing authenticated registry owner read (http_registry_entry_reader); no ALPHA_REPLICATION_DATA_DIR / backtest_runs.json mount, no new setting.
implemented.pool_entry_point: persona_strategy_pool.py PersonaStrategyPoolStore.member_baselines (read-only, keyed by pool_version, artifact_ref, checksum)
implemented.owner_binding: POST /api/registry/strategy-artifacts takes replication_proof plus the producer's full backtest_evaluation. PromotionGate.verify_admitted_replication_proof recomputes the evaluation digest (BacktestRunStore canonical form), artifact checksum/run/status/governed TW vectorbt binding, OOS Sharpe/drawdown/round trips, and every real_backtest_validation check (GateConfig thresholds, deflated threshold from trial_count, walk-forward) and requires summary, details and checks to equal them; replication_success is derived by the registry. The binding is persisted on the entry and returned by the existing GET.
implemented.gate_basis_alignment: member_virtual_book computes the gate-basis block only when every underlying is observed with identical bar times (marks_complete); otherwise gate_basis.unavailable_reason (underlying_marks_missing / histories_not_aligned_to_common_window) and the comparison is member_metric_missing.
implemented.research_owner_readback: services/research/main.py GET /api/research-orchestrator/backtest-runs/{run_id}/owner-binding: strict Research verifier, registry-writer plus existing service roles (viewer not admitted), served only when the server-owned backtest_run_owners.json record (written by the retrain gate that ran the protocol) names the authenticated tenant; foreign/unbound/historical runs 404. services/registry/service.py _verify_research_run_owner forwards the original caller bearer (RAM only, 5s timeout, no redirects) to RESEARCH_ORCHESTRATOR_API_URL and refuses the proof unless tenant/status/digest/checksum equal the gate recomputation; persists owner_verified_binding.producer_verified.
implemented.owner_gate_verdict_and_producer_registra: Research persists the real gate decision (admission_status, trial_count, mandate_max_drawdown, family_id, real_backtest_validation digest) in the server-owned run owner record and serves it via owner-binding readback as gate_verdict; the Registry compares it to the submitted proof's context and refuses any mismatch/missing/rejected verdict, so a caller cannot reconstruct a rejected or different-trial gate (trial 50 rejected vs claimed trial 1 is refused). research/main.py register_child now POSTs the real replication_proof, exact backtest_evaluation, canonical evaluation_summary and producer_run_id=backtest run via _producer_proof_registration. Local unit evidence only; the retrain /mutate registration path is not changed.
